verdicts.reason: A: the green circle is cut off from the phone and left as a blank blob on the left. The tagline is stranded at the far right after the phone, so the reading order breaks. The CTA and the two pills sit jammed together in one row, which puts the button on the same level as the badges. B has the same circle-and-phone split and the same crowded CTA row, and it is worse: the tagline sits on top of the circle and is pressed against the left edge of the canvas, so the ad opens with small secondary copy and the hierarchy is wrong.
